evidence.snippet: Before using the lark-mcp tool, you need to create a Feishu/Lark application

Log in to
Developer Console
to create a company custom app, and then go to the details page of the app to obtain its App ID and App Secret.
Unlimited: Core features including Authentication and Authorization, Event Subscription, and Contacts are free to use, regardless of your Lark plan.

decisions.reason: Any developer can self-register, create a custom app, and immediately obtain App ID/App Secret and call unlimited/basic APIs for free, with no sales contact or admin approval needed to get working credentials (though higher usage may need a paid Lark plan or advanced API package).
